initial_model: matched original FUSION790 epoch40; new optimizer; encoder and normalizers frozen
normal_upper: weighted 90th percentile of original model full FIT normal scores
normal_risk: E_full_FIT_normal[relu((score-upper)/original_FIT_scale)^2] estimated by fixed stratified draw set
attack_preservation: E_full_FIT_attack[relu((baseline-score)/original_FIT_scale-0.01)^2] estimated by fixed stratified draw set
context_preservation: E_full_FIT_attack[1(lift0>0)*relu((0.9*lift0-lift)/original_FIT_scale)^2] estimated by fixed stratified draw set
attack_tolerance: 0.01 original FIT scale; soft penalty, not a guaranteed hard constraint
context_intervention: zero normalized 8 columns; off-manifold diagnostic regularizer only
pilot_weights: For each draw in stratum g use Wg/ng, never multiply original row weight again; existing balanced minibatch n_class/batch_class scaling unchanged
threshold_policy: original FUSION790 per-seed and ensemble CAL thresholds fixed; no recalibration
primary_endpoint: retained state after fixed fifth source-guarded proposal round, never CAL-selected
external_use: unchanged old engineering encoder/distance/metric replay only; candidate never scored externally
limitations: Source CAL previously used to set original cuts and is not a fresh test.
FIT outside pilot was used by original model; holdout only for this fine-tuning.
Source protection does not guarantee Edge attack preservation.
Upper-tail compression may transfer poorly; report NO_GO rather than tune to Edge.
No new independent test; CAL has been inspected diagnostically.
Three model seeds share a single sampling realization, not independent sampling replicates.
Same step budget and full-source target; not the same realized empirical objective as old uniform subset.
Strata coverage does not guarantee within-stratum tail coverage or better detection.
With-replacement fixed sample optimization can overfit; estimator expectation does not guarantee adaptive gradient unbiasedness.
All FIT now participates in optimization feedback; non-gradient FIT is not validation.
Per-seed source guard does not guarantee CAL, external or ensemble quantile preservation.
Original soft loss retained; finite guard prevents storing rejected round endpoints only.
Backtracking may stall; report zero accepted progress rather than expanding time or relaxing guards.
Guarded vs historical control has different compute; report actual attempted and retained updates.
sampling: Within label: semantic strata (device,activity,protocol); one draw minimum per stratum, largest remainder allocation of remaining draws proportional to full FIT class mass; conditional PPS with replacement
intended_target: full FIT per-class hierarchical expectation; unbiased design expectation for fixed parameters before sampling, not an adaptive optimization unbiasedness claim
control: Frozen source_stratified_pilot_v1 epoch5 endpoint; identical sampling identities/weights, teacher, loss, baseline optimizer; guarded LR replay adds compute and may retain fewer steps
sample_count_semantics: 8192 draws per class; duplicate source identities allowed; actual unique identities reported; fixed draw set reused over five epochs
updates_count_semantics: 320 nominal proposal slots, up to1280 actual optimizer steps; retained optimizer steps<=320; runtime negative controls separately reported

guard.acceptance: All original per-seed source scientific criteria plus full FIT normal tail risk nonincrease from previous retained state
guard.rollback: restore complete model, Adam moments/step counters and torch RNG before every attempt; all fail restores previous retained state

preflight_actual_steps: 8 nominal, up to32 on replay; plus4 forced one-step rejections to verify complete state restoration
